description: This file defines abstract base classes for data repositories in a streaming platform backend, including UserRepository, VideoRepository, and HistoryRepository, all inheriting from a common BaseRepository.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: Abstract base class for data repository interfaces.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Abstract repository interface for user data operations.

classes.name: VideoRepository
classes.description: Abstract repository interface for video data operations.

classes.name: HistoryRepository
classes.description: Abstract repository interface for watch history data operations.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_user(self, email: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new user with email and password hash.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_email(self, email: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve user information by email.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve user information by user ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_videos(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to list all videos.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_video(self, video_id: int)
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a specific video by its ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] upsert_history(self, user_id: int, video_id: int, position_seconds: int)
methods.description: Abstract method to insert or update watch history for a user and video.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_history_for_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Abstract method to list watch history for a specific user.
